description:
Implement src/memory.rs (cfg(feature='memory')) and tests/*.rs.

## src/memory.rs

Cookie-cut from jmap-sharing-server::memory::MemoryBackend pattern:
- HashMap<(type_name, account_id), HashMap<Id, serde_json::Value>> for object storage
- Per-(type,account) monotonic state counter
- Change log per (type,account)
- json_merge_patch from jmap-server for update_object
- Async impls for JmapBackend (get_objects/get_state/get_changes/query_objects/query_changes) and MetadataBackend (create/update/destroy/supports_type)
- module-level #[deny(clippy::await_holding_lock)]
- MUST enforce the Metadata-specific server-side uniqueness constraint (relatedType, relatedId, @type, isPrivate) per draft §3.1 — return BackendSetError::SetError(alreadyExists{existingId:...}) from create_object when the constraint is violated. This is the one Metadata-specific piece of the memory backend.
- The maySetPrivate / quota / relatedType validation enforcement: stub or no-op (returns Ok) — these are configurable per-backend behaviors that integration tests can exercise via a customized backend, not the bare reference impl.

## tests/

- tests/common/mod.rs — shared test helpers (single_call, capability URI constant)
- tests/metadata_get_tests.rs — dispatcher-level Metadata/get tests
- tests/metadata_set_tests.rs — Metadata/set create/update/destroy + uniqueness/forbidden/notFound
- tests/metadata_changes_tests.rs — filterRelatedType / filterMetadataType behavior
- tests/metadata_query_tests.rs — text_match + relatedType filtering

Each test uses MemoryBackend, hand-written draft example JSON as the oracle, and dispatcher-level assertions (not just direct handler calls).

## Acceptance
- cargo test -p jmap-metadata-server --all-features clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server --all-features --tests -- -D warnings clean
- cargo doc -p jmap-metadata-server --all-features --no-deps clean
- MemoryBackend uniqueness constraint test passes
